title: Advertising as a Reminder: Evidence from the Dutch State Lottery
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Minute-level national lottery ticket sales regressed on distributed lags of continuous TV and radio advertising GRPs (grp_tvL0-grp_tvL235, grp_radioL0-L235) with date-by-hour FE (groupDayHour), clustered by date; additional OLS with draw, days-to-draw and hour dummies, draw-level sales regressions on jackpot size, and a structural goodwill model (MATLAB). Treatment is continuous ad exposure in a single national time series, not a binary staggered adoption.
design_notes: Stata analysisHeKleinReminder.do (reduced form) and MATLAB main.m (Section 7 structural estimates). Placebo leads (grpF*) and small/big ad splits are robustness variants of the same distributed-lag model.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: continuous GRP distributed lags in a national minute-level time series; no cross-sectional units with adoption dates

data_files_note: README: 'We are unfortunately not able to provide the data.' Code only.
